page: Microsoft Azure M32bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processor with 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It lacks local storage, requiring external block storage, but is premium storage capable. No GPU accelerators are included.

Benchmark data indicates strong memory and single-core performance. The server achieves top-tier results in Geekbench single-core testing, image processing, and text processing. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth is strong at 182.67 GB/sec, while write bandwidth remains average at 86.71 GB/sec. Multi-threaded decompression and static web serving throughput also rank in the top 25%. However, multi-core CPU performance and database operations fall within the average tier.

The hardware includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX, which assist in low-latency operations. While small-model LLM text generation is highly efficient, text generation for large 70B models is weak, averaging 2.74 tokens/sec due to the lack of dedicated GPU acceleration. This server is suited for memory-intensive workloads, enterprise database hosting, and memory-cached web serving, offering a balanced resource density for memory-bound applications without the overhead of local storage maintenance.
